what: Release-facing units sidecar for the frozen resource-envelope artifacts. It classifies every numeric field as a physical vehicle count, a modeled peak-concurrency proxy, revenue vehicle-hours, a dimensionless share, or another explicitly defined unit, and records where each value comes from. The envelope artifacts themselves are frozen and unchanged; their `contract_text` and field names use physical-vehicle language for proxy quantities, so wording and unit labels must be taken from this file, never from them (docs/process/RELEASE_AND_REPORTING_GUIDELINES.md, report rule 4).

physical_vehicle_count.label: vehicles (block-derived, existing schedule only)
physical_vehicle_count.meaning: A count of physical buses. In this study the only physical counts are COTA's vehicle blocks reconstructed from the published schedule (including interlining) and the NTD-reported vehicles in maximum service. They describe the existing schedule only; no modified plan has a physical vehicle count.

modeled_peak_concurrency_proxy.label: peak-concurrency proxy units (not vehicles)
modeled_peak_concurrency_proxy.meaning: Sum over routes of cycle time / headway in a period (cycle = 2 x runtime x (1 + layover)): the solver's resource instrument. It ignores interlining and deadhead and is not a bus count.

revenue_vehicle_hours.label: revenue vehicle-hours per weekday
revenue_vehicle_hours.meaning: Scheduled weekday revenue vehicle-hours from GTFS.

dimensionless_share.label: % or fraction
dimensionless_share.meaning: A ratio, share, tolerance or percentage difference.

other.label: see field definition
other.meaning: A unit defined on the field itself (time of day, a count of blocks or route-periods, a digest).

weekday_revenue_vehicle_hours.provenance: outputs/experiments/exp1_frequency_redistribution_20260826T003902Z/experiment.json (GTFS scheduled; reproduced by exp2.build_setup to better than 1e-9)

peak_vehicles.provenance: outputs/fleet_check_modelB.json: COTA vehicle blocks reconstructed from the feed at 17:13, 284 blocks

peak_time.unit: time of day (HH:MM), the block-derived peak

ntd_reported_voms.provenance: NTD 2024 Annual Agency Profile, NTD ID 50016 (vehicles operated in maximum service, all bus modes)

NOT_THE_CAP.frequency_model_peak_concurr.provenance: FitnessVector.peak_vehicles on the baseline plan, pm peak (with the 1.307 interlining factor)

NOT_THE_CAP.optimized_plan_usage.example.provenance: one optimized plan's realised hours (an output, never a cap)

peak_fleet_by_period.early.provenance: FrequencyModel.peak_vehicles (cycle/headway) on the unedited reference network, frozen 2026-09-22; the field name says 'fleet' but the quantity is the proxy

agreement_with_audit_reference_worst_abs.provenance: worst absolute difference against the audit reference vector
